facts.statement: Antarctaspis is an extinct genus of arthrodire placoderm fish known only from a single species.
facts.quote: Antarctaspis (meaning "Antarctica's shield") is an extinct monospecific genus of arthrodire placoderm fish

facts.statement: The type species Antarctaspis mcmurdoensis was described by White in 1968.
facts.quote: The type species Antarctaspis mcmurdoensis was described White in 1968

facts.statement: Antarctaspis lived in Antarctica during the Givetian age of the Devonian period.
facts.quote: which existed in Antarctica during the Givetian age of the Devonian period

facts.statement: The genus Antarctaspis existed from 410.62 to 382.31 million years ago, spanning the Emsian to Givetian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Emsian to Givetian (410.62 to 382.31 million years ago)

facts.statement: Antarctaspis belongs to the family Antarctaspididae.
Antarctaspis is classified within the class Placodermi.
Antarctaspis is considered one of the most basal members of the order Arthrodira and is closely related to the genus Yujiangolepis.
facts.quote: It is one of the more basal members of the order Arthrodira, closely related to Yujiangolepis

rejected.statement: Fossils of Antarctaspis are known from a partial head shield found in the Lashly Mountains of Antarctica.
